snippet.title: Tiny Flock Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tiny Flock is a beautifully realized, cozy physics-based puzzle game built exclusively for VR. 

Your mission is simple: guide your adorable wayward sheep to their inviting pasture by interacting with the environment around to create safe passage. How you do it can be entirely up to you – but be careful, as where you lead they will follow – and the grass is not always greener! 

Each level is a beautifully crafted 3D diorama with a fully interactive environment.
Create paths and bridges, stack and throw objects, pull ropes and levers to create a safe passage for your adorable sheep. There are no set solutions—just physics, creativity, and the environment around you – plus a tiny flock of very patient, slightly wayward sheep!

Whether you engineer a careful solution or blast your way through, Tiny Flock rewards curiosity and experimentation.

Key features:
- Herd your tiny flock through 21 beautifully hand-crafted diorama levels 
- Built exclusively for VR with full hand-tracking and pass-through support on Meta Quest 
- A fully interactive world—build bridges, smash objects, pull levers, and solve puzzles your way.
- Custom-built physics gives an amazingly tactile, satisfying gaming experience unlike anything else in VR
- Achievements and collectibles for replayability and completionists 
- Original music soundtrack — a magnificent cello score to match the cozy puzzle atmosphere.
